name: Research Runner
description: Books NVIDIA GPU time on the Prism Network for CUDA workloads and analysis too sensitive for shared machines, with confidential prompts encrypted before they leave. Aimed at developers and researchers already comfortable with crypto-based infrastructure; overkill for anything that would run fine locally.
